title: Date ideas for when you're both exhausted

slides.title: Date ideas for when you’re *both exhausted*
Takeout and *a rewatch.*
slides.body: Order your usual. Put on the show you’ve both seen ten times.

slides.title: Face mask *night.*
slides.body: Two face masks, one bad movie, zero talking about work.

slides.title: Picnic *in bed.*
slides.body: Whatever’s in the kitchen. Crumbs are allowed tonight.

slides.title: Read *side by side.*
slides.body: Same sofa, different books. Read the best line out loud.

slides.title: A slow walk *around the block.*
slides.body: No destination. Phones in pockets. Just walk.

slides.title: An early night, *together.*
slides.body: Lights off early. Talk until one of you falls asleep.

slides.title: Save this *for your next long week.*
slides.sub: Then send it to the one who just said “I’m so tired.”
